extracted.name: Amazing Cucumber Basil Salad
extracted.description: This basil salad with crunchy cucumber, red onion, tomatoes, and spinach makes its own refreshing dressing after marinating in the fridge overnight.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound campari tomatoes, seeded and minced
2 large seedless cucumbers, peeled and minced
1 teaspoon cracked black pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Process spinach and basil in a food processor until finely chopped.
Toss together spinach mixture, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, garlic, salt, and pepper in a large bowl with an airtight lid. Cover the bowl and refrigerate salad, 8 hours to overnight.
